speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Right hip dislocation.

Based on your immediate pain in the right groin and the mechanism of injury from the rear-end collision, I suspect a hip dislocation. Can you describe the specific position of your right leg now—is it bent inward and rotated forward, or is it straight and rotated backward?
